79/**
80 * @brief Scene definition within a .superdex_scene.
81 *
82 * The base_scene is optional — a scene under construction may not have one yet. When present it is
83 * the authoritative source for all simulation physics parameters (gravity, solver config, contact
84 * filtering, collision layers, etc.); when absent the scene keeps its default parameters.
85 */
86struct BaseSceneParams {
87 /// Path to a .mochi_scene file. Defines the scene foundation. Empty means no base scene.
88 DynamicString baseScene;
89
90 /// Prefabs that can be loaded/destroyed on demand at runtime (e.g. task objects spawned each
91 /// episode).
92 DynamicArray<PrefabEntry> spawnablePrefabs;
93
94 /// Where this scene's task frame (the nominal table top) is in the world. Every task's root-level
95 /// spawns are placed onto it, through @ref BotTaskPrefab::taskRootOffset when the task declares
96 /// one; see @ref ComputeWorldFromTask. Unset leaves every task where its own coordinates put it.
97 std::optional<TransformRT> taskRoot;
98
99 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BaseSceneParams)
100 MOCHI_FIELD(baseScene)
101 MOCHI_FIELD(spawnablePrefabs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
102 MOCHI_FIELD(taskRoot) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
103 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
104};

106/**
107 * @brief A controller instance to create and attach to a bot.
108 */
109struct ControllerEntry {
110 /// Controller type identifier (registered string), e.g. "BASIC_OSC_PD", "BASIC_JSC_PD".
111 DynamicString type;
112
113 /// Instance name for runtime lookup.
114 DynamicString name;
115
116 /// Controller-specific parameters as a raw JSON string. Omit to use defaults.
117 DynamicString params;
118
119 /* The controller's init args as a serialized JSON object -- the contents of the scene entry's
120 * nested "initArgs" object (e.g. {"baseLinkName":..,"eeLinkName":..} for link-resolved
121 * controllers, or a model path for a learned controller). Passed verbatim to
122 * ControllerBase::ConfigureFromSceneEntry, which deserializes it into a controller-specific
123 * struct, so the scene loader never needs to know a controller's fields. Reflected with the
124 * JsonString attribute: on load the nested "initArgs" object is captured into this string, and on
125 * save it is re-emitted as a nested object (round-trip identity), so no bespoke parsing is
126 * needed. May also be set or modified directly (e.g. from Python) before LoadBotScene. Defaults
127 * to an empty object ("{}"), which NoSerializeDefaults omits from the saved file. (Legacy scenes
128 * that interleave flat controller fields instead of a nested "initArgs" object are folded into
129 * this string at load time -- see LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile; new scenes and all saves use the
130 * nested form.) */
131 DynamicString initArgs = DynamicString("{}");
132
133 // IgnoreExtraneousFields lets legacy scenes -- which interleave controller-specific keys (e.g.
134 // baseLinkName/eeLinkName) as flat siblings -- load without tripping strict extraneous-field
135 // validation; those keys are folded into initArgs at load time.
136 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::ControllerEntry)
137 MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(IgnoreExtraneousFields);
138 MOCHI_FIELD(type)
139 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
140 MOCHI_FIELD(params)
141 MOCHI_FIELD(initArgs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(JsonString) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
142 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
143};
144
145/**
146 * @brief A bot (robot) to instantiate in the scene.
147 */
148struct BotEntry {
149 /// Unique instance name (used for runtime lookup via GetBot(name)).
150 DynamicString name;
151
152 /** @brief Path to a .superdex_bot or .superdex_bot_archive file (self-contained or mod bot). */
153 DynamicString path;
154
155 /// Bot placement relative to the scene root (aFromB convention: maps bot-frame coordinates into
156 /// the scene frame). Default: identity.
157 TransformRT parentFromBot;
158
159 /// Initial joint angles (length = total DOFs of the bot).
160 DynamicArray<real> initialPose;
161
162 /// False builds every link of the bot without gravity, as for a robot whose own controller
163 /// compensates gravity; the scene's other actors keep theirs.
164 bool hasGravity = true;
165
166 /// Controllers to create and attach to this bot.
167 DynamicArray<ControllerEntry> controllers;
168
169 /// Key naming the teleoperator rig that drives this bot; the consumer maps it to a concrete
170 /// class. Empty means use the consumer's default for the slot this bot fills.
171 DynamicString roboperatorClass;
172
173 // --- LEGACY (remove once all .mochi_bot_scene assets carry `parentFromBot`) ---
174 // Older assets stored placement as separate flat `translation`/`rotation` keys. These capture
175 // them on load; LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile folds them into `parentFromBot` and clears them (so
176 // re-saves omit them). TODO(superdex): delete these fields, the MOCHI_FIELD_NAME lines, and the
177 // fold.
178 Real3 _legacyTranslation = {};
179 Quaternion _legacyRotation = {};
180
181 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotEntry)
182 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
183 MOCHI_FIELD(path)
184 MOCHI_FIELD(parentFromBot) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
185 MOCHI_FIELD(initialPose) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
186 MOCHI_FIELD(hasGravity) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
187 MOCHI_FIELD(controllers) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
188 MOCHI_FIELD(roboperatorClass) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
189 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyTranslation, "translation") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
190 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyRotation, "rotation") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
191 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
192};

194/**
195 * @brief One slot a scene offers, and the bots eligible to fill it.
196 */
197struct SlotEntry {
198 /* Unique slot name within the scene, e.g. "right". Names a role, not a bot. */
199 DynamicString name;
200
201 /* Names of @ref BotEntry entries that may fill this slot. A consumer picks at most one per
202 * slot; superdex validates that each named bot exists and is listed once, and nothing else.
203 * Which slots a scene has, and what they mean, is the scene's business, not superdex's. */
204 DynamicArray<DynamicString> controlledBots;
205
206 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::SlotEntry)
207 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
208 MOCHI_FIELD(controlledBots)
209 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
210};

212/**
213 * @brief A scene-level sensor (not attached to any bot).
214 *
215 * Useful for environment-level observations such as overhead cameras, force plates,
216 * or proximity sensors mounted on fixtures.
217 */
218struct SceneSensorEntry {
219 /// Sensor type identifier (registered string), e.g. "SENSOR_CAMERA".
220 DynamicString type;
221
222 /// Unique instance name for runtime lookup.
223 DynamicString name;
224
225 /* Sensor graph inputs. Bot-owned inputs use their complete "bot/link/sensor" graph name. */
226 DynamicArray<DynamicString> inputs;
227
228 /// Sensor pose relative to the scene root (aFromB convention: maps sensor-frame coordinates into
229 /// the parent scene frame). Chain to world via SensorBase::GetWorldTransform. Default: identity.
230 TransformRT parentFromSensor;
231
232 /** @brief Sensor-specific parameters: a path to a .superdex_sensor JSON file, an inline JSON
233 * object, or empty to use the sensor type defaults. */
234 DynamicString params;
235
236 // --- LEGACY (remove once all .mochi_bot_scene assets carry `parentFromSensor`) ---
237 // Older assets stored the pose as separate flat `translation`/`rotation` keys plus a
238 // now-vestigial `attachTo` string. These two fields capture the flat keys on load;
239 // LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile folds them into `parentFromSensor` and clears them (so re-saves omit
240 // them). `attachTo` is absorbed by IgnoreExtraneousFields and dropped. TODO(superdex): delete
241 // these fields, the MOCHI_FIELD_NAME lines, IgnoreExtraneousFields, and the fold in
242 // LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile.
243 Real3 _legacyTranslation = {};
244 Quaternion _legacyRotation = {};
245
246 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::SceneSensorEntry)
247 MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(IgnoreExtraneousFields);
248 MOCHI_FIELD(type)
249 MOCHI_FIELD(name)
250 MOCHI_FIELD(inputs) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
251 MOCHI_FIELD(parentFromSensor) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
252 MOCHI_FIELD(params)
253 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyTranslation, "translation") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
254 MOCHI_FIELD_NAME(_legacyRotation, "rotation") MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
255 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
256};

258/**
259 * @brief Complete parameter set for a .superdex_scene file.
260 *
261 * A .superdex_scene is a JSON config that serves as the single source of truth for a complete
262 * simulation environment. It unifies scene geometry, robots, controllers, and sensors.
263 */
264struct BotScenePrefab {
265 /// Human-readable metadata. Not consumed by the runtime.
266 BotSceneMetadata metadata;
267
268 /// Scene definition. The base_scene is optional.
269 BaseSceneParams scene;
270
271 /// Robots to instantiate.
272 DynamicArray<BotEntry> bots;
273
274 /// Scene-level sensors (not attached to any bot).
275 DynamicArray<SceneSensorEntry> sensors;
276
277 /* Slots this scene offers, and which bots may fill each. A map in meaning, an array of named
278 * entries in the file, as every other named collection in this schema is. Empty means the
279 * scene declares no slots and offers no choice: consumers instantiate its bots as they find
280 * them. */
281 DynamicArray<SlotEntry> slots;
282
283 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::BotScenePrefab)
284 MOCHI_FIELD(metadata) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
285 MOCHI_FIELD(scene)
286 MOCHI_FIELD(bots) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
287 MOCHI_FIELD(sensors) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
288 MOCHI_FIELD(slots) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(NoSerializeDefaults);
289 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
290};

292/**
293 * @brief Load bot scene parameters from a .superdex_scene JSON file.
294 *
295 * Deserializes the file, validates that bot, controller, and spawnable-prefab names are non-empty
296 * and unique, and resolves relative paths to absolute. A scene with no base scene and no bots is
297 * valid — that is the state of a newly created scene.
298 *
299 * @param[in] path File path to the .superdex_scene file.
300 * @param[in,out] error Error status. Check @ref Error::IsOK for success.
301 * @return Loaded @ref BotScenePrefab, or default-constructed on failure.
302 */
303MOCHI_API BotScenePrefab LoadBotScenePrefabFromFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error);
304
305/**
306 * @brief Returns an already-loaded @ref BotPrefab for a bot entry's path, or nullptr to have it
307 * loaded from file. The returned prefab must stay valid until the call it was passed to returns.
308 */
309using BotPrefabLookup = std::function<BotPrefab const*(std::string_view botPath)>;
310
311/**
312 * @brief Changes a spawnable prefab as its file declares it, before its nested prefabs and shapes
313 * load (e.g. an actor's shape scale). An edit that sets @p error spawns nothing.
314 */
315using SpawnPrefabEdit =
316 std::function<void(superdex::prefab::ScenePrefab& prefab, superdex::Error& error)>;
317
318/**
319 * @brief Changes a declared bot's prefab after it loads, placed and posed as its scene entry
320 * declares, and before the bot is created (e.g. its links' gravity or mass). It sees the bot's
321 * entry, so entries that share one bot file can be changed differently. An edit that sets
322 * @p error stops the bot from being created.
323 */
324using BotPrefabEdit =
325 std::function<void(BotEntry const& entry, BotPrefab& prefab, superdex::Error& error)>;
326
327/**
328 * @brief The fields an edit changed in a prefab, as a JSON object: @p edited's fields that differ
329 * from @p original's. An array of named objects (links, joints, actors) becomes an object of each
330 * changed element's changed fields, keyed by its name. Numbers keep every bit, so a recording that
331 * carries the result rebuilds what the edit made (see @ref LoadBotScene and
332 * @ref BotScene::SpawnPrefabInstance, which take it). Empty when nothing differs.
333 */
334MOCHI_API DynamicString DiffPrefab(BotPrefab const& original, BotPrefab const& edited);
335MOCHI_API DynamicString
336DiffPrefab(superdex::prefab::ScenePrefab const& original, superdex::prefab::ScenePrefab const& edited);

350/**
351 * @brief A render model (e.g. a .glb) drawn for one actor or articulated link, in place of its
352 * collision shape.
353 */
354struct ActorRenderModel {
355 /// Absolute path of the render model file.
356 DynamicString file;
357 /// Pose of the model in the actor's (or link's) frame.
358 TransformRT actorFromModel;
359 /// Scale of the model along its own axes, including any prefab and actor scale.
360 Real3 scale = {1_r, 1_r, 1_r};
361};
362
363/**
364 * @brief The render model of a bot's deformable skin, skinned over the bot's links.
365 *
366 * @details The model's vertices are posed by linear blend skinning: bone b carries a vertex from
367 * its rest pose to rootFromBone_b(current) * inverse(rootFromBoneRest[b]). Rest poses are those of
368 * the bot's links at the zero pose, the convention the skin is authored in; the model's own
369 * inverse-bind matrices are not used.
370 */
371struct ActorSkinRenderModel {
372 /// Absolute path of the skinned render model file.
373 DynamicString file;
374 /// Pose of the model in the bot's root frame at the rest pose.
375 TransformRT rootFromModel;
376 /// Scale of the model along its own axes.
377 Real3 scale = {1_r, 1_r, 1_r};
378 /// Per skin bone (joint of the model's skin, in order): the link actor it binds to, or an invalid
379 /// handle if the bone names a link the bot does not have.
380 DynamicArray<ActorHandle> boneLinks;
381 /// Per skin bone: the rest pose of its link in the bot's root frame (identity for an invalid
382 /// bone).
383 DynamicArray<TransformRT> rootFromBoneRest;
384 /// Link actors whose rigid render models the skin stands in for (see ComputeSkinHiddenLinks).
385 DynamicArray<ActorHandle> hiddenLinks;
386};

388/**
389 * @brief Runtime representation of a loaded .superdex_scene.
390 *
391 * Owns the physics scene and provides named lookup for bots, controllers, sensors, actuators, and
392 * spawnable prefabs. This is NOT a prefab — it composes data from both mochi_physics and
393 * mochi_bots.
394 */
395class MOCHI_API BotScene {
396 public:
397 ~BotScene();
398
399 /* Non-copyable, movable. */
400 BotScene(BotScene const&) = delete;
401 BotScene& operator=(BotScene const&) = delete;
402 BotScene(BotScene&&) noexcept;
403 BotScene& operator=(BotScene&&) noexcept;
404
405 /* @brief Get the physics scene.
406 * @return Physics scene, or nullptr if it is unavailable. */
407 [[nodiscard]] Scene* GetScene() const;
408
409 /* @brief Get the Mochi context.
410 * @return Mochi context, or nullptr if this BotScene is moved from. */
411 [[nodiscard]] Context* GetMochiContext() const;
412
413 /* @brief Get the robotics context (bot/controller/sensor/actuator resource owner).
414 * @return Robotics context, or nullptr if unavailable. */
415 [[nodiscard]] RoboticsContext* GetRoboticsContext() const;
416
417 /* @brief Get the scene's borrowed sensor graph. Graph access and membership changes must be
418 * serialized on the physics stepping thread. */
419 [[nodiscard]] SensorGraph* GetSensorGraph() const;
420
421 /* @brief Reset the built graph and its acquisition clock; samples await the next physics step. */
422 void ResetSensors(superdex::Error& error);
423
424 /* @brief Reconstruct the declared graph, select caller-supplied outputs and reset acquisition.
425 * Use for an explicit acquisition restart. Failure leaves the graph unbuilt.
426 * This does not reset physics, controllers or task state. */
427 void RebuildSensorGraph(Span<DynamicString const> outputs, superdex::Error& error);
428
429 /* @brief Surface any error captured by the native post-physics sensor callback. */
430 void CheckSensorGraph(superdex::Error& error) const;
431
432 /* @brief Look up a bot by the name declared in the .superdex_scene file.
433 * @param name Exact declared bot name.
434 * @return Loaded bot, or nullptr if the name is not found or this BotScene is moved from. */
435 [[nodiscard]] Bot* GetBot(std::string_view name) const;
436
437 /* Get (loading on first use) a bot for a spawnable prefab whose path is a
438 * .superdex_bot_archive / .superdex_bot, by the name declared in the
439 * .superdex_scene file's spawnablePrefabs. Unlike SpawnPrefabInstance (which
440 * places a named instance), this instantiates the spawnable once per name
441 * as an articulated Bot (CreateBot) so callers can access its articulated
442 * actor (e.g. for FK). The bot is created at identity root; callers that need
443 * placement set the actor pose themselves. Cached per name and owned by this
444 * BotScene. Returns nullptr and sets error if the name is unknown or its
445 * prefab is not a bot archive.
446 * @param name Spawnable-prefab name declared in this scene.
447 * @param error Error status.
448 * @return Cached or newly instantiated articulated bot, or nullptr on error. */
449 Bot* GetOrLoadSpawnableBot(std::string_view name, superdex::Error& error);
450
451 /* @brief Spawn a spawnable prefab under an instance name at a world pose. The same prefab may be
452 * spawned any number of times under distinct instance names. A .superdex_bot /
453 * .superdex_bot_archive spawnable is instantiated as an articulated Bot named after the instance
454 * and rooted at worldFromInstance; the instance owns it.
455 * @param instanceName Unique instance name; must not already be live.
456 * @param prefabName Spawnable-prefab name declared in this scene.
457 * @param worldFromInstance Instance root pose in world space.
458 * @param error Error status.
459 * @return Actor handles in prefab::AddToScene order (for a bot, its articulated actor), or empty
460 * on error. Valid until the instance is destroyed. */
461 Span<ActorHandle const> SpawnPrefabInstance(
462 std::string_view instanceName,
463 std::string_view prefabName,
464 TransformRT const& worldFromInstance,
465 superdex::Error& error);
466
467 /* @brief Like the overload above, with @p edit, a @ref DiffPrefab result, set in the prefab
468 * before its shapes load, e.g. to rebuild a recorded spawn. An empty edit changes nothing; one
469 * that does not fit the prefab spawns nothing. */
470 Span<ActorHandle const> SpawnPrefabInstance(
471 std::string_view instanceName,
472 std::string_view prefabName,
473 TransformRT const& worldFromInstance,
474 std::string_view edit,
475 superdex::Error& error);
476
477 /* @brief Like @ref SpawnPrefabInstance, with @p edit applied to the prefab before its nested
478 * prefabs and shapes load (see @ref SpawnPrefabEdit). A bot-file spawnable is not a prefab, so it
479 * refuses an edit. C++ only. */
480 Span<ActorHandle const> SpawnEditedPrefabInstance(
481 std::string_view instanceName,
482 std::string_view prefabName,
483 TransformRT const& worldFromInstance,
484 SpawnPrefabEdit const& edit,
485 superdex::Error& error);
486
487 /* @brief Destroy a prefab instance created by @ref SpawnPrefabInstance.
488 * @param instanceName Name of a currently live instance.
489 * @param error Error status. */
490 void DestroyPrefabInstance(std::string_view instanceName, superdex::Error& error);
491
492 /* Destroy every live prefab instance. Used for episode reset, where the caller
493 * wants a clean slate without tracking which spawns succeeded. */
494 void DestroyAllPrefabInstances();
495
496 /* @brief Get the actor handles of a live prefab instance.
497 * @param instanceName Instance name passed to @ref SpawnPrefabInstance.
498 * @return Actor handles in prefab::AddToScene order, or empty if not live. */
499 [[nodiscard]] Span<ActorHandle const> GetPrefabInstanceActors(
500 std::string_view instanceName) const;
501
502 /* @brief Get the names of every live prefab instance, in creation order. */
503 [[nodiscard]] DynamicArray<DynamicString> GetPrefabInstanceNames() const;
504
505 /* Retire a bot loaded from the .superdex_scene: destroy its controllers, actuators, sensors,
506 * and articulated actor (actuators and sensors hold link-actor pointers, so they are destroyed
507 * before the actor), then erase it from the bot registry so scene teardown does not
508 * double-destroy it. Prunes its sensor nodes and downstream dependants before destruction,
509 * preserving other sensors, enabled outputs and the acquisition clock.
510 * Errors if no bot named `name` is loaded.
511 * @param name Exact declared name of the loaded bot to remove.
512 * @param error Error status. */
513 void RemoveBot(std::string_view name, superdex::Error& error);
514
515 /* Instantiate a bot the .superdex_scene declares but that is not loaded -- one left out of the
516 * scene's botsToInitialize, or removed with @ref RemoveBot -- together with its controllers, at
517 * its declared placement and initial pose. Its prefab is loaded from file, and changed by the
518 * @ref BotPrefabEdit the scene was loaded with, if any. Errors, creating nothing, if no bot named
519 * `name` is declared, it is already loaded, or it fails to instantiate. Extends the graph without
520 * resetting existing sensors or changing enabled outputs. Added nodes start disabled.
521 * @param name Exact declared name of the bot to initialize.
522 * @param error Error status.
523 * @return The loaded bot, or nullptr on error. */
524 Bot* InitializeBot(std::string_view name, superdex::Error& error);
525
526 /* @brief Enable canonical graph output names and initialize their newly active dependencies.
527 * Existing sensor state and selections survive; an empty list does nothing.
528 * @param sensor_outputs Canonical names of existing graph nodes to select.
529 * @param error Error status. */
530 void AddSensorOutputs(Span<DynamicString const> sensor_outputs, superdex::Error& error);
531
532 /* @brief Enumerate the graph's current selected outputs in dependency order.
533 * Borrowed view invalidated by graph mutation or destruction; empty while unbuilt. */
534 [[nodiscard]] Span<SensorGraphNodeView const> GetSensorOutputs() const;
535
536 /* @brief Get the original parameters this BotScene was loaded from.
537 * @return Original scene parameters, or an empty prefab if this BotScene is moved from. */
538 [[nodiscard]] BotScenePrefab const& GetBotScenePrefab() const;
539
540 /* @brief Get a controller handle by key (borrowed reference).
541 * The BotScene retains ownership — the handle remains valid as long as
542 * the BotScene is alive. Access the concrete controller via
543 * GetRoboticsContext()->GetController(handle) and downcast.
544 * @param key Controller key in "botName/controllerName" format.
545 * @return The controller handle, or an invalid handle if not found. */
546 [[nodiscard]] ControllerHandle GetControllerHandle(std::string_view key) const;
547
548 /* @brief Find controllers in the associated @ref RoboticsContext whose instance name equals
549 * @p name. This includes components from any other BotScene sharing the context.
550 * @param name Exact instance name to match.
551 * @return Handles of every match in creation order; empty if none or the context is unavailable.
552 */
553 [[nodiscard]] DynamicArray<ControllerHandle> FindControllersByName(std::string_view name) const;
554
555 /* @brief Find controllers in the associated @ref RoboticsContext whose registered type name
556 * equals @p typeName. This includes components from any other BotScene sharing the context.
557 * @param typeName Exact registered type name to match.
558 * @return Handles of every match in creation order; empty if none or the context is unavailable.
559 */
560 [[nodiscard]] DynamicArray<ControllerHandle> FindControllersByType(
561 std::string_view typeName) const;
562
563 /* @brief Find sensors in the associated @ref RoboticsContext whose instance name equals
564 * @p name. This includes components from any other BotScene sharing the context.
565 * @param name Exact instance name to match.
566 * @return Handles of every match in creation order; empty if none or the context is unavailable.
567 */
568 [[nodiscard]] DynamicArray<SensorHandle> FindSensorsByName(std::string_view name) const;

596 /* @brief Resolve a termination criterion's task-object reference to its current world pose.
597 *
598 * Resolution keys off Mochi actor names, which every task spawner derives from the spawn name:
599 * `<spawn>.<sub>` is the actor named exactly `<spawn>/<sub>` (a prefab companion, or a bot's
600 * link); a bare `<spawn>` is the actor named `<spawn>` (a bot's articulated actor) or else the
601 * spawn's first `<spawn>/...` actor. A spawn registered through @ref SpawnPrefabInstance is
602 * looked up in that registry first. An articulated actor's pose is its root frame where link 0
603 * has carried it, not where the actor was placed.
604 * @param ref Task-object reference as written in a criterion.
605 * @return World pose, or nullopt if the reference does not resolve. */
606 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<TaskObjectPose> ResolveTaskObjectPose(std::string_view ref) const;

608 /* @brief Begin deciding @p task's termination criteria from episode time zero, replacing any
609 * already in progress.
610 *
611 * The criteria are evaluated after every physics step of this scene, on the stepping thread,
612 * against episode time summed from the step sizes. Every consumer therefore gets the same
613 * decisions at the same simulated instants, however often it reads them. Safe to call from any
614 * thread.
615 * @param task The task whose spawns were applied to this scene. Its criteria are copied. */
616 void StartTermination(BotTaskPrefab const& task);
617
618 /* @brief Stop deciding termination criteria. Safe to call from any thread; no evaluation is in
619 * progress once it returns. */
620 void StopTermination();
621
622 /* @brief Clear progress toward the criteria — held results, latches, dwell — without restarting
623 * the episode clock, for task objects that were just re-placed. Safe to call from any thread. */
624 void RestartTerminationProgress();
625
626 /* @brief The outcome of the criteria begun by @ref StartTermination.
627 *
628 * Sticky: the first step on which either outcome is reached is frozen until the next start or
629 * stop, so a consumer reading less often than the scene steps cannot miss an outcome that held
630 * only briefly. With no criteria in progress, neither outcome is authored. Safe to call from any
631 * thread.
632 * @return Both outcomes. */
633 [[nodiscard]] TerminationOutcome GetTerminationOutcome() const;
